notes_for_us: Simulation has no shape for a small natural scene. Every typical shape is either a plot, a persistent shared world or a tiered grind ladder, so a fly-fishing creek has to borrow space-bounded from the catalogue. Given how many Roblox fishing games there are, that is a shortlist worth revisiting.

collectible-nodes is layout-only in Simulation's table, but in this prompt the fish are the thing the user most wants to see — 'clear water' exists so you can watch them. Role Sim was the closest preset by loop shape and the worst by content: two of its three options are roads and circulation for a job with vehicles. A fishing prompt matching a trucking preset suggests the Simulation presets are indexed on the economy rather than the space.

notes_for_us: Triage worked exactly as step 0 promises on the largest prompt in this batch: a spec that is nine tenths netcode, AI, UI and balance produced a clean nine-item stadium and a mechanics array that lost nothing. What the skill does not say is how granular mechanics entries should be — I emitted nineteen, and a lane summarising the same prompt in five would look like it dropped three quarters of it.

backstage-support is the right option for a players' tunnel and its P3 makes it unusable for one. The route is listed as a consequence of a feature that is present, but the override table only sanctions dropping P3 for settlement shapes, so a facade tunnel has no legal path to an ID.

Sports has no row for a display structure, yet a scoreboard is close to universal in the genre — I had to reach into Party & Casual for tracker-leaderboard, whose wording is a lobby wall. Worth a Sports-worded row given the genre note says field specs are known quantities and stadium dressing is the common build.
